caption: The drawing depicts a detailed image of a fitted bodice, likely from a historical dress. The bodice is rendered in soft pastel tones, predominantly a light pink or peach color, and features intricate floral embroidery in multiple colors including blue, green, red, yellow, and purple scattered throughout the fabric. The neckline is off-the-shoulder and trimmed with pale yellow lace. The short sleeves are adorned with additional lace that drapes downward, and gathered bands are present near the arms. The front of the bodice displays a prominent large bow at the center made of the same fabric as the rest of the garment. The bodice features a pointed, elongated bottom edge, giving it a distinct shape. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned, and there are some handwritten notations visible along the upper left edge.
title: Bodice
